p: Joseph was bound: God works in many wonderful ways to deliver his own.
each man according to the interpretation: That is, every dream had his interpretation, as the thing afterward declared.
Do not interpretations belong to God: Cannot God raise up such as shall interpret such things.
is the interpretation of it: He was reassured by the spirit of God, that his interpretation was true.
make mention of me unto Pharaoh: He does not refuse the method of deliverance which he thought God had appointed.
white baskets on my head: That is made of white twigs, or as some read, baskets full of holes.
This is the interpretation thereof: He shows that the ministers of God should not conceal that, which God reveals to them.
birthday: Which was an occasion to appoint his officers, and to examine those who were in prison.
